definitions.full: H542. omman אָמָּן ( omm¹n ) noun masculine master-workman, artist Cant 7:2 (Mishna, Talmud אוּמָנוּת אוּמָן, handiwork , Syriac ᵑ6 Exod 28:11 , where = Hebrew חָרָשׁ & is likewise used of gems; Nabataean אמנא Vog 94 , Assyrian mar umm'ni , Lyon Sargontexte 65 , compare Zim BP 12 ; compare II. אָמוֺן ).
